description: This file defines React components for a command palette interface, utilizing Radix UI primitives and cmdk library components, with styling and composition specific to this feature.

classes.name: Command
classes.description: A styled wrapper around the cmdk Command component, handling ref forwarding and className composition.

classes.name: CommandDialog
classes.description: A React component that renders a dialog containing a command palette styled with cmdk and Radix UI primitives.

classes.name: CommandInput
classes.description: A styled command input component with a search icon, designed for filtering command options.

classes.name: CommandList
classes.description: A scrollable container for command items, styled for maximum height and overflow control.

classes.name: CommandEmpty
classes.description: A styled component displayed when no command results match.

classes.name: CommandGroup
classes.description: A grouping component for command items with styling for headers and grouping behavior.

classes.name: CommandItem
classes.description: An individual selectable command item with styling for disabled and selected states.

classes.name: CommandShortcut
classes.description: A small text span for displaying keyboard shortcuts associated with commands.

methods.name: React.forwardRef
methods.description: Used to create React components that can accept refs and forward them to DOM elements or child components.

methods.name: cn
methods.description: Utility function for conditional className composition, imported from utils.
